audit.whatIsWrong: Content win[] hands Sion levels 2, 3 and first item while its own whys say you win the level-2 trade, that level 3 is 'roughly even' and that first item can 'still even' out. Full phases mirrors the same mistake.
audit.why: packet.levelChart is Skill, Gragas, Skill, Gragas, Gragas, Skill, Sion at a 50.96% win rate — the prose already argues exactly that shape.
audit.corrected: Level 1 even, Level 2 Gragas, Level 3 even, Levels 4-5 Gragas, Level 6 Gragas, first item even, two items Sion.

audit.whatIsWrong: Soul Furnace is treated as a flat shield with no timing. It re-activates after 3 seconds for max-health magic damage and is on 15/14/13/12/11s, which is the actual all-in window.
audit.why: enemyKit W text and cd. Baiting it buys an 11-15 second stretch where his only defensive layer is gone — that is when your 6 and first-item spikes cash.
audit.corrected: Bait Soul Furnace with an early Barrel Roll, then all-in inside its 15s cooldown; expect the re-activation AOE 3 seconds after he shields.

audit.whatIsWrong: Roar of the Slayer is described only as armour-shred poke. If it hits a minion first it KNOCKS THAT MINION BACK through everyone behind it, damaging, slowing and shredding armour along the way — so standing behind your wave extends his poke instead of blocking it.
audit.why: Riot text: 'If the shockwave hits a minion or monster, it will be knocked back, damaging, slowing, and reducing the Armor of all enemies that it passes through.' Also unstated: only a fully charged Decimating Smash knocks up — a quick release is damage only.
audit.corrected: Side-step out of the minion line, not behind it; and read his Q charge time — a snap release cannot knock you up.

audit.whatIsWrong: The early, mid, late and whys[0] blocks are written in first person ('I take Q and W', 'my tower', "we're both weak"). Every other page on the site is second person.
audit.why: Voice break — the coach text should address the player directly.
audit.corrected: Rewritten in second person with no length change.

audit.why: Both suspectNames ('Pop Soul Furnace', 'My Body Slam') are false positives on the names themselves; 'My Body Slam' is a voice problem, not a naming one, and is handled above.

edits.before: Neither of us threatens much at level 1 — I have one ability and no Happy Hour reset yet, so just last-hit. At 2 I take Q and W: drink for the empowered, max-HP-scaling auto, and Happy Hour plus my damage reduction wins the short trade his Roar (E) armor-shred poke opens. The trap is his charged Q — if I throw a lazy Body Slam to engage, he holds the charge and knocks me up, so only E him when his Decimating Smash is down or uncharged.
edits.after: Neither of you threatens much at level 1 — one ability each and no Happy Hour reset yet, so last-hit. At 2 take Q and W: drink for the empowered, max-HP-scaling auto, and Happy Hour plus damage reduction wins the short trade his Roar (E) poke opens. Roar knocks a minion back through you, so hiding behind the wave extends his poke instead of blocking it. Only Body Slam him when Decimating Smash is uncharged — a lazy engage into a held charge is a free knockup.

edits.before: This is my best stretch. W max plus Happy Hour means I out-sustain his Roar poke in any extended trade, and at 6 my E-stun into W-auto-Q is a genuine kill — Body Slam him, drink-auto, sweetspot the fermented Q, then Cask him off his minions toward my tower. Watch his Soul Furnace: if he shields right as I commit, my burst gets absorbed and he reactivates W for a max-HP AOE, so bait the shield with an early Q, then all-in once it's down and on cooldown.
edits.after: This is your best stretch. W max plus Happy Hour means you out-sustain his Roar poke in any extended trade, and at 6 the E-stun into W-auto-Q is a genuine kill — Body Slam him, drink-auto, sweetspot the fermented Q, then Cask him off his minions toward your tower. Watch Soul Furnace: shield up as you commit and your burst is absorbed, then he re-activates it three seconds later for max-HP AOE, so bait it with an early Q and all-in inside its 15s cooldown.

edits.before: The lane flips the longer it goes. Sion is a pure tank scaler — he just stacks resists and outlasts my burst, and his Glory in Death zombie passive means even a clean kill can trade me my engage. My Body Slam is telegraphed and his charged Q knockup interrupts it cleanly, so late I stop dueling and play utility: Explosive Cask to peel my carries or knock him into my team. Close it on my 6 or first-item spike, or accept he out-values me at full build.
edits.after: The lane flips the longer it goes. Body Slam is telegraphed and a charged Q knockup interrupts it, so late you stop dueling and play utility: Explosive Cask to peel your carries or knock him into your team. Close it on your 6 or first-item spike, or accept he out-values you at full build.

notes: Two things worth the user's attention. First, this page was written in first person — 'I take Q and W', 'my tower' — across early, mid, late and whys[0]; nothing else on the site reads that way, so it is worth a grep for other first-person pages. Second, the full layer has diff = 'HARD' while diffRating is 4/10, tone is the green #3ddc97, and report[14] says 'Favoured matchup' — the label is the odd one out. I did not change it because I have no list of valid diff tokens (see questionsForUser). Also noting a derived-flag misfire: Sion's R carries a 'terrain: creates terrain' flag, but Riot's description is only a steerable charge that knocks up on collision — I did not write any terrain claim into the page.
